bibliographic.abstract: In this short note, we report on the first inelastic neutron scattering (INS) study on high-energy magnetic excitations in Sr3Ir2O7. We observed excitations between ∼80 meV and ∼180 meV. The peak position of the excitations is consistent with the dispersion of a single magnon determined by resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) measurement. Thus, our results demonstrate the feasibility of INS for iridates, which has a large neutron absorption cross-section.

section_headings: Magnetic excitations of Sr3Ir2O7 observed by inelastic neutron scattering measurement
Iridate oxides, Sr2IrO4 and Sr3Ir2O7, are Mott insulators with spin-orbit entangled magnetic state bearing the effective total angular moment, J eff = 1/2.

Inelastic neutron scattering (INS) that directly measures the dynamical structure factor, S( Q , hbar omega), in the momentum ( Q ) and energy (hbar omega) spaces is also an indispensable method for investigating spin dynamics.
For the experiment, we prepared single crystals by the fluxmethod.
Figure 1 shows the spectra along the k-direction through (0.5, ± 0.5) corresponding to the antiferromagnetic (AF) zone center (ZC).
From the figure, the scattering intensity for | k | > 0.5 is weak or absent, leading to the asymmetric spectra with respect to ZC ( k = ± 0.5).
To determine the gap energy at the AF zone boundary (ZB), we sliced the spectra at (0.25, 0.25) along the energy direction.
In Fig. 3, the momentum dependence of the peak-position and intensity are presented.

From these results, we conclude the feasibility of the INS measurements on excitations in iridate oxides and that INS and RIXS detected identical excitations in the iridate oxides, as in the case of La2CuO4.
In summary, we performed INS measurement on Sr3Ir2O7, and successfully, observed the excitations between ∼80 meV and ∼180 meV.

samples.sample_description: Prepared by the fluxmethod. Maximum size 2 mm x 2 mm x 1.5 mm. Approximately 500 crystals with a total mass of 2.1 grams were assembled on aluminum plates (with 0.1 mm thickness) such that the crystallographic c-axis is perpendicular to each plate.

datasets.dataset_description: INS measurements were performed on 4 SEASONS at the Materials and Life Science Experimental Facility (MLF) at J-PARC, Japan. A 250 meV incident neutron energy (Ei) was selected to determine the magnon excitations below 200 meV. This Ei with a chopper frequency of 250 Hz provided an energy resolution (Delta E) of 12.6 meV at hbar omega = 150 meV. The signals were collected for two days under 300 kW beam power operation at 6 K.
